method: Verify every official PDF original byte SHA, page count, current file CreationDate/ModDate and whether first-page distribution/embargo text is extractable. Compare creation date with Korean page registration. Retain both files in three dual-version months; report all ambiguity, do not choose version. Use one Qlib D.calendar for descriptive next-US-session clocks.
decision: Even a file created at/before stated distribution time does not by itself prove first public receipt or no later revision; no historical PIT qualification without independent vintage. Numeric factor parsing and market outcome remain separate frozen phases.
stops: Missing source bytes, changed source/page identity or PDF parse errors before Recorder
No version selection or strategy result from current PDF metadata
